basics.name: Yang Wang
basics.summary: First-year master's student at Fudan University, advised by Prof. Xipeng Qiu and Prof. Yaqian Zhou. My research focuses on audio understanding, audio generation, and voice agents, covering the full pipeline from data construction and model training to deployment and interactive applications.
